wikipedia.title: Roserock Solar
wikipedia.extract: The  Roserock Solar Facility is a 157 MWAC (212 MWp)  photovoltaic power station in Pecos County, Texas.  It was the largest solar project in Texas when completed in late 2016.  The facility is dispersed over about 1300 acres of land already developed for oil and gas by Apache Corporation.  It is located about a mile north of Interstate-10, and 20 miles west of Fort Stockton.
